answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch-specific polynomial whose committed coefficients bind each Semaphore identity to its RLN secret. Exceeding the message rate reveals Shamir shares through valid proofs at distinct inputs; those shares reconstruct the private key, allowing verified, immediate collateral slashing. This makes Sybil identities costly: a dawn surge, ripple of duplicate posts, or ivory-bright alias still risks the same bonded loss.
